meta.name: dis_members
meta.note: instruction_set_members of the family digest: D(IS)'s members from their pages, ordered by title (code point order), each h the SHA-256 of the page's preformatted blocks joined by one line feed, written here from literal block texts and digested apart from the Calculator. A case with specification_pages and page also checks that the member's h equals the h specification_pages answers for that page. A case with refused instead of expect is refused by the Calculator itself (the request's arguments or the family bound): its refusal word and detail are refused's.

refused.detail: titles holds more than 1000 entries (the Calculator's bound)
pages holds more than 1000 entries (the Calculator's bound)
titles holds more than 1000 entries (the Calculator's bound)
